notes.title: WANNA PLAY NEW UPDATE'S BETA?
notes.notes:
[b]Everyone can play the beta version of the new update[/b]

To do this you need:
1. In the library, using RMB on "Destroke" in the list of games, go to "Properties..."
2. In the "Beta Versions" section, select the "beta" option in the "Beta testing" section
3. Now, when you click "Play" when choosing the option to start the game, select the second option

[b]Done! If you want to return to the stable version of the game, go to "Properties", return the first option "No" in the "Beta versions" section in the "Beta testing" section. When starting the game, select the first launch option.[/b]
